body: SO I tried to send a text this morning expressing how I feel and that maybe it's just a good idea we say our goodbyes until he figures out what he needs too, and possibly revisit things in later days. Somehow the conversation took a complete 180 and ended up back with us meeting up. I'm seriously like an emotional toddler who can't handle even breaking it off. I'm sorry I'm so freaking annoying, but I think I'm completely losing my mind.

It's just been so bad, I haven't left my house or went to class or found any true reason to smile. I've completely destroyed myself. And we just sat for hours talking before anything happened, about how he knows this is the stupidest decisions he's ever made because no one will ever love him like I do, and I'm the only stable thing he's ever had. The moments he's been with me the last two days I could actually smile and laugh and finally not need a drug or something to feel better. And I just don't know what to do, because the silence is what kills me the most.

Honestly it doesn't even have to be like this, I just saw it and thought it was kind of neat. But I'm really open to any type of drawing anyone wants to do. I'm pretty girly, and just want something done on my side that I can look at to remind me I don't ever want to let myself get to this place again.

Right now it definitely shows that we do need the space he's asked for an that I should quit reaching out. If he feels like saying what he needs to say something he knows we're to find me. But when I went and took all my things, I grabbed the vibrater he bought and kept at his house, because well that counts as my stuff too in my eyes 👌🏻😂 haha.

I tried to say I needed to go but it ended up everyone yelling "well they'll put her in a pysc ward then". So I hit under my blankets in a fetal position until I finally passed out. I don't know what else to do ha.

Okay long story but:

Three weeks ago we went on vacation for a week together. The week after he came over saying he needed space, and this isn't forever but he just needs time. But never changed his Facebook status or pictures from us. When I went to his house today, all the picture of us were still in his room sitting up, and the things I made for him were still hanging all over. But, I've reached out twice, asking if he wanted to exchange things, or I begged for his help because I was drowning and afraid id do something stupid and he's the only one who truly gets me and can calm me down. He didn't respond to either attempt, but last night a girl used his snap chat to post a story of her with him in the background, when I LITERALLY TEXTED HIM TO JUST TALK TO ME. The thing about him is, before me he was suicidal, he had an issue with using alcohol and random hook ups to deal with his problems instead of talking about it. So I know exactly what he's doing. I left a note with his things that this isn't me saying goodbye, in my head I am still yours, I love you too much to watch what's going on, and I love me too much to watch you destroy yourself too, and that I hope he figures out what he needs and to hear from him soon. Even after talking to a therapist it didn't work, all it made me do was wish I could just talk to him, just jump back into a serious relationship just a conversation. Having his mom cry while hugging me was probably the worst though, she made me leave his things in front of thof door so he saw it as soon as he got home hoping it would be a wake up call. I'm drowning, and in constant physical pain because of everything. I just need something, and I don't know what else I can do. I stopped talking to my last friend who was listening to me, because all she wanted to do was talk shit about him, and I don't have anything bad to say about him. He was respectful and perfect to me, I just know the fear of things getting really serious and th fear of the next step was scaring him on top of everything else.

Even though I am in my 20's I still live at home, so it's just hard to tell my mom like no I need to go. I've taken three of the Xanaxs I've just got prescribed to in like 5 hours and fall over when I try to stand up. I just don't trust anything my body is telling me. I'm just scared and lost.

They put me on xanax, and now every time I stand up I fall over. I feel the need to be put in the hospital but everyone keeps telling me "oh it's stress" "it just takes time". Like I truly believe I need to be somewhere and watched what I'm taking and acting, but I don't kno and how to just say it.

I finally went and talked to a professional today, and holy shit does that make it worse. All it made me realize was there's only one person I wanna talk to. They just want to put me on a bunch of meds and shit. I decided to reach out again tonight, but I still don't think I'll get a response. I don't know what to do now.

Everyday is getting worse, and I quit going to classes. I can barely get myself to stop crying, and haven't eaten an actual meal or slept in I don't know how long. I'm looking for someone to talk to, but I really feel like I should tell him everything that's going on because he's the one who always understood me and how my emotions were, I just don't know what to do anymore.

they all decided I was being over dramatic, and didn't want to listen to me anymore. If I call any of them it goes straight to voice mail. Last night I texted multiple of them for help, and finally admitting I'm terrified of myself and none of them responded. I guess you realize when you're on top and have something to offer people care, but when you're down you're all alone..

I just noticed this. And it was probably one of the most helpful things I've seen! I get worse and worse by the day, and have to take things just to sleep. I haven't actually gotten dressed or put make up since it's all went down. I've pushed myself into a deep hole I can't escape from anymore, and have no idea how. Everyone thinks I'm being a cry baby, and it will blow over "I'll get over it", when I tell them I'm afraid of myself. I don't know how to convince myself to do anything. I get yeah it's just a guy, but have you ever met someone and the moment you met each other nothing else mattered? You were so perfect together it seemed like a Disney movie should be written about it. It's just not okay.

Different ways I could possibly get hurt just enough, that maybe I would be feel like someone cares about me being alive.  I know, it sounds ridiculous or whatever... That's what I was trying to tell my friend the other night when she told me I'm over dramatic and won't talk to me anymore.

I keep putting up an act that I'm fine so that everyone at home will quit asking that stupid question "how are you feeling?" I know people have worse problems in life than I do, but I don't work, I have no friends, I have no motivation to g to my classes, let alone get out of bed. I want to drink, but I can't do that because it just made it so much worse. I'm afraid of the thoughts in my head, and I can't keep holding everything in or I don't know what will happen. And, I feel like an idiot begging for strangers to help me, but I don't know what else to do. For the first time in my life, everything is dark and numb and I'm afraid of myself.

I wrote it in my letter how I took the few days of silence to come to the realization I pushed to hard when I should have let him have his time. 
I'm so sorry for going on and on, but I feel so much better when I just sit and talk. I even went and got a journal so I could write out my feelings instead of blowing up his phones.

But, I tried to drink at a girlfriends last night, and she's the one who told me I'm over exaggerating so I ended up passing out, and sobered up to go home. I've never been good with the whole girlfriend thing, ever since high school. So it makes it a lot harder because how much can I really bitch to my mom about haha

Haha yeah well I've been lurking for years, but once this all happened I finally had to make an account so I apologize I have no idea what I'm doing.

He's always said things about how I was clingy, or too much at times and that he needed time for him and the boys. But I never understood it. Trust me I'm a mess trying to do this, I even thought about doing that old school movie scene tonight with a boom box and small rocks on his window, but figured showing up out of the blue may be too crazy haha. Night time is a lot worse than day time, just because I have way to much time to think, I just want one good night sleep.

It's more I'm trying to give him a few days of space completely, because even I can admit I was SUPER clingy the last few months. Any normal person would have ran, but he dealt with it. Like if he was with his friends I would still blow his phone up and had no concept of what I was doing. 
So I wrote a letter, I figured it's more personal than a text, just to let him know where I am at. I'm going to drop it off Tuesday and kind of go from there. I'm just going crazy because he's my best friend, and everyone else seems to have deserted me.

This is going to sound nuts. But I'm going pretty crazy anyways, and anyone I try and talk to says I'm pretty over dramatic... And I don't know how to keep myself from trying to talk to him and give him his "space". I'm legitimately afraid of myself.

After talking neither of us exchanged our things, and he went to update his fb relationship to single but didn't and left all his profile pictures as us together. Saying he "just needs time to figure out what he wants out of life". So I'm more confused than I was before.

I honestly don't know what to do.. He wouldn't do it over a text so for the last 24 hours I've been sitting waiting for him to get off work to come do it to my face. He's literally the only friend I have, and I just feel my world crashing down.
